mapper.select: SELECT p.language AS language, r.residence_code AS residenceTypeCode, v.visa_code AS visaTypeCode, p.job AS job FROM member_profiles p LEFT JOIN residence_types r ON r.residence_type_id = p.residence_type_id LEFT JOIN visa_types v ON v.visa_type_id = p.visa_type_id WHERE p.member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.update: UPDATE member_profiles SET language = #{row.language}, residence_type_id = (SELECT residence_type_id FROM residence_types WHERE residence_code = #{row.residenceTypeCode}), visa_type_id = (SELECT visa_type_id FROM visa_types WHERE visa_code = #{row.visaTypeCode}), job = #{row.job}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_profiles (member_id, language, residence_type_id, visa_type_id, job) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{row.language}, (SELECT residence_type_id FROM residence_types WHERE residence_code = #{row.residenceTypeCode}), (SELECT visa_type_id FROM visa_types WHERE visa_code = #{row.visaTypeCode}), #{row.job})
mapper.select: SELECT residence_code AS code, residence_name AS name FROM residence_types ORDER BY residence_type_id
SELECT visa_code AS code, visa_name AS name FROM visa_types ORDER BY visa_type_id
